name: Newsroom AI Assistant
author: koskar22

sections.description:
Newsroom AI Assistant is a tool for the Editor-in-Chief and the journalism team. Developed and tested on active news portals like Patrapress.gr, it helps organize your newsroom tasks and optimize your content formatting.

🎯 Task Manager

With our Editorial Tasks & Alerts system, the Editor-in-Chief can:
* Create upcoming events (e.g., “Elections”, “Black Friday”).
* Assign topics to specific authors directly inside WordPress.
* Set “Lead Days” so the assigned journalist gets a sticky reminder badge exactly when they need to start writing.

🚀 Free Features Included:

  • Live Google Trends (Geo-Targeted): View the top trending searches in your country (US, UK, Greece, India, etc.) in real-time.
  • Smart Internal Linking: Scan your database and insert highly relevant “Read Also” links with one click.
  • AI Prompts Generator: Generate engineered prompts to use with your preferred AI (ChatGPT/Gemini) that will:
    • Suggest click-worthy Discover titles.
    • Format text with H2/H3 tags and output JSON-LD FAQ Schema.
    • Extract SEO tags and a Meta Description.
  • Bilingual UI: Fully supports English and Greek interfaces.

👑 Coming Soon: The PRO Version (AI Automation)

We are currently developing the PRO version which will connect directly to OpenAI/Gemini APIs, allowing the AI to write and format text directly inside your editor.

Support & Contact: Need help or want to request a feature? Contact the developer at koskar22@gmail.com.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to your WordPress admin panel and navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Click Upload Plugin and choose the zip file.
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  5. Go to the new AI Assistant menu in your dashboard to set your language and preferred region.
